cohort: The study included all children born in Sweden between 1982-1989 and 1999-2014, totaling 2,442,330 participants.
finding: The study found an increased risk of B-cell precursor ALL among children delivered by planned Cesarean section, particularly in boys and at peak ALL incidence ages.
mod_finding: Planned Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of B-cell precursor ALL, while unplanned Cesarean section was not associated with an increased risk of childhood ALL.
